# GitHub Copilot Instructions

This file contains GitHub Copilot-specific guidance for the bachelor's thesis repository.

Project context and general development rules are documented in [docs/DEVELOPMENT_GUIDELINES.md](../docs/DEVELOPMENT_GUIDELINES.md).

Use Copilot to support implementation, explanation, review, and language improvement, but do not use it as a substitute for your own reasoning or authorship.

Any AI-generated code or text must be reviewed, understood, tested, and validated by the author before it is accepted.

Keep Copilot suggestions aligned with the existing architecture, thesis scope, and beginner-friendly style of the project.
